Name: Explosion
Description: Shadows darker than darkness expand out of your arcane focus, while a deep crimson circle appears around the blast radius before erupting. Every creature within a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. When the spell has finished casting you fall prone, your speed drops to 0, and you become incapacitated until after your next turn.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the base damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.
